# Luxume Roofing

> Luxume is a colour-coated steel sheet manufacturer headquartered in Ernakulam, Kerala, India, founded in 2011. Luxume manufactures premium colour-coated (pre-painted) steel sheets used for roofing, wall cladding, and fabrication in the construction industry, offered in standard "Luxume" and "Luxume Plus" product lines.

Products are sold through an authorised dealer network across Kerala and South India. Contact: info@luxume.in, +91 97785 57752.

## Products

- [Product range](https://www.luxume.in/products): Colour-coated steel roofing and cladding profiles, finishes and colour options.
- [Luxume](https://www.luxume.in/products/luxume): Standard colour-coated line, 10-year limited guarantee against perforation.
- [Luxume Plus](https://www.luxume.in/products/luxume-plus): Premium line, 15-year limited guarantee against perforation.
- [Luxume Silverlux](https://www.luxume.in/products/luxume-silverlux): Silverlux finish variant.

## Guarantee and specifications

- [Guarantee terms and conditions](https://www.luxume.in/guarantee): Full limited-guarantee terms for colour-coated coil and sheet used in roofing and cladding. Covers the RMP paint system, 10-year (Luxume) and 15-year (Luxume Plus) perforation cover, and colour-change limits measured to ASTM D2244-93.
- [Do's and Don'ts](https://www.luxume.in/dos-and-donts): Handling, storage, installation and maintenance guidance — including ventilation and moisture requirements during storage.

## Company

- [About Luxume](https://www.luxume.in/about): Company history from 2011, manufacturing approach, mission and vision.
- [Projects](https://www.luxume.in/projects): Completed residential, commercial and industrial installations.
- [Contact](https://www.luxume.in/contact): Address, phone, email and enquiry form.
- [Careers](https://www.luxume.in/careers): Current openings.

## Notes for AI crawlers

- Canonical domain is https://www.luxume.in (the apex redirects to www).
- Sitemap: https://www.luxume.in/sitemap.xml
- The guarantee, do's-and-don'ts and about pages carry the most specific,
  citable technical detail (warranty durations, ASTM references, storage
  requirements) and are fully server-rendered.
- Product, project, blog and careers pages are server-rendered with their full
  content; the sitemap enumerates every URL including detail pages.
